package.name: orion_f1tenth
package.description: Real-world ORION deployment on an F1TENTH car: one camera on the Jetson AGX Orin feeding ORION's six camera slots (front three from the camera, rear three black), pose / speed / global path from the F1TENTH stack on the Jetson Nano, ORION inference on the Orin with the orion_ros speedups (fast / int8 profiles), and simlingo_f1tenth's trajectory controller driving the Nano's /drive topic.
